draft.shortGloss: to travel; to go on a trip
draft.emotion: wide-eyed and eager, looking forward to the next adventure
notes: Forms its perfect tense with 'sein' ('Ich bin nach Italien gereist').
Unlike 'fahren' (going by vehicle), 'reisen' is used for longer journeys or traveling in general ('Ich reise gern').

senses.definition: To go from one place to another, especially over a long distance or on a trip.
